mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement_decision (universe_id, decision_data, is_confirmed, trace_id, gmt_create, gmt_modified) VALUES (#{universeId}, #{decisionData}, #{isConfirmed, jdbcType=TINYINT}, #{traceId}, NOW(), NOW())
